purpose: Wonder aloud using a soft sentence ending.
keywords: I wonder whether it will be sunny tomorrow.
I wonder where I put the key.
I wonder whether these clothes will be all right.
restrictions: Choice depends on speaker style and social context, not grammatical gender agreement.
mistake: Avoid treating it as a universally neutral formal question ending.

segments.role: Wonder aloud using a soft sentence ending. Plain clause + かしら.
